title: Season 2: Things You Can't Live Without
summary: Join Dr Anna Ploszajski in Season 2 of Rio Tinto's podcast 'Things You Can't Live Without' as she discusses the truths about our reliance on the earth’s resources and the need for sustainable futures with renowned guests and scientists.
body_markdown:
### How do the objects we rely on come to be made? What goes into creating them? How did they become so vital to us? And what is the environmental impact of living with them, now and into the future?


Join material scientist Dr Anna Ploszajski as she welcomes different guests and scientists to discuss the truths about our reliance on the earth’s resources – and to look at what needs to happen to create a sustainable future for the everyday items we have come to rely on.


Things You Can’t Live Without season 2 – listen now on[Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/show/2wEd4gdGHcbi7pbj246ufn) ,[Apple](https://podcasts.apple.com/gb/podcast/things-you-cant-live-without/id1732003388) ,[Amazon](https://music.amazon.com/podcasts/4fde7fdd-564a-401b-8071-58672ca0b330/things-you-can%27t-live-without) and[YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLKmZm8JPWnNRQm3ge0MvOmo9lSL_2lrs3) .
